title: HTTP designer request
description: The JSON body POSTed to an HTTP-bound filter designer -- design/designer-interface.md §7.1, implemented caller-side by pipeline.designer.http_binding.http_designer(). One POST per DesignRequest (§2). Aimed at implementers in any language, unlike the rest of the Python-dataclass-shaped contract.

contract_version.description: echo this back unchanged in the response; 1.1 adds only response fields (rejected, rejection_reasons); 1.2 adds an array sent by reference (#/$defs/ndarray_file), and a caller sends "1.2" only when the body holds one

fs.description: sample rate (Hz) of mono_mix and every array in channels

coverage.description: design/designer-interface.md §2 -- whether mono_mix spans the entire title or something less

mono_mix.description: 1-D, the primary signal to design against

channels.description: optional per-channel decomposition, keyed by channel label ("L", "R", "C", "LFE", "Ls", "Rs", etc.); null when not supplied. Each array is 1-D, the same length as mono_mix, and time-aligned with it.

bass_management.description: the caller's bass-management configuration, if it has one; null otherwise. Meaningful only together with channels.

headroom_type.description: "WCS" (worst-case-scenario coherent summation) or a fixed headroom in dB as a numeric string

ndarray.description: one array, inline (every version) or, from 1.2, by reference -- never both

ndarray_file.description: 1.2: a 1-D float64 array named by reference -- one column of a WAV under a root both sides see -- instead of carried inline (design/designer-interface.md §7.1, "Arrays by reference"). Sent only to a designer configured for it.

shape.description: a single-element array: the WAV's frame count, which must match

path.description: POSIX-style, relative to the shared root the designer is configured with: never absolute, no backslash, no '..' segment. The designer also refuses a path whose real path (symlinks resolved) is outside its root.

channel.description: zero-based column of the WAV; must be below its channel count

sha256.description: lower-case hex SHA-256 of the decoded column as a C-contiguous little-endian float64 1-D array of shape[0] elements -- the exact bytes data_base64 would have carried. Checked before the array is used.

ndarray_inline.description: A 1-D float64 array, base64-encoded as raw little-endian bytes -- not a JSON number array (a 2-hour, 1kHz mono_mix is ~58MB as float64; JSON text bloats that 3-5x for no benefit on a same-machine/LAN call).

dtype.description: travels explicitly rather than being assumed, so a future widening isn't a silent breaking change. "float64" is the only value v1 produces or accepts.

shape.description: 1-D only in v1 -- a single-element array of the element count

data_base64.description: base64 encoding of the array's raw little-endian float64 bytes (numpy's native '<f8' byte order)
